title: GraphVisor input document
description: Shape of input/<collection>/<id>.json. Only fields the pipeline uses; extra fields are ignored. Source-specific cleanup (dropping non-content sections, etc.) is the job of whatever produces these files. Which pipeline steps run depends on which optional fields are present: see input/README.md.

id.description: Document id within the collection. Defaults to the filename without .json.

doi.description: Enables exact citation lookup in OpenAlex; otherwise matched by title.

abstract.description: If missing or empty, the pipeline generates one.

citations.description: Citation count. If present, the citation lookup is skipped.

body.description: Argument-bearing paragraphs in reading order. The pipeline rebuilds the full text from them (headings as section titles) and sends it to the wiig chunker, exactly like OCR output.

headings.description: Section path, outermost first, e.g. ["Results", "Autophagy flux"].
